title: Matching Holi Outfits for Family and Friends: Group Style Ideas
excerpt: Matching Holi outfits for family and friends without looking like a uniform: colour themes, print pairings and easy ideas for every group.
body:
Matching Holi outfits make group photos look wonderful, but the best groups coordinate rather than copy. Choose a colour theme, mix silhouettes and let each person pick what suits them. With Holi 2027 on 22 March, start planning together now so everyone's outfit arrives in time.

## Coordinate, do not clone

Everyone wearing the exact same outfit can feel stiff. Instead, choose one link that ties the group together: a shared colour, a shared print style or a shared neutral base. Each person then picks the silhouette they feel best in, whether that is a kurta set, a tunic with jeans or a maxi dress.

This approach works for every body type and age, from teenagers to grandmothers, and photos still look planned.

## Five group themes that work

**1. White plus one accent colour.** Everyone wears white or off-white with one shared accent, such as a yellow dupatta or pink bangles. Classic and easy for big families.

**2. Pastel rainbow.** Each person wears a different pastel: mint, peach, sky blue, lavender, lemon. Together the group looks like a palette.

**3. Block print family.** Everyone wears a hand block print in their own colour. The common craft ties the look together.

**4. Sunshine and leaf.** Yellows, greens and corals, the colours of spring.

**5. Tunic and denim gang.** Friends wear different coloured cotton tunics with jeans. Relaxed, practical and perfect for a party abroad.

## Pick the right theme for your group

| Group | Suggested theme | Outfit ideas |
|---|---|---|
| Mother and daughters | Pastel rainbow | Kurta sets in mint, peach and sage |
| Sisters or cousins | Block print family | Palazzo sets and tunics in different prints |
| College friends | Tunic and denim gang | Bright tunics with jeans and sneakers |
| Whole family with kids | White plus one accent | White outfits with a shared colour dupatta or accessory |
| Couples' friend group | Sunshine and leaf | Yellow, green and coral pieces |

## Outfit ideas for the women in your group

For a pastel or block print theme, mix full sets and separates. The [mint green block print kurta set with hand work yoke](/products/mint-green-hand-block-print-cotton-kurta-pant-dupatta-set-with-hand-work-yoke/) is soft and fresh.

The [sage teal block print kurta palazzo set](/products/sage-teal-block-print-cotton-kurta-palazzo-set/) sits beautifully next to it in photos, so a mother and daughter could wear one each.

For a brighter sunshine theme, cotton tunics are ideal because they are easy to mix and budget-friendly for a group. Try the [yellow embroidered tunic with black floral yoke](/products/yellow-black-embroidered-cotton-tunic-top/) with jeans for one friend.

Another friend can wear the [coral pink block print tunic](/products/coral-pink-hand-block-print-cotton-tunic-top/) the same way, and the two look great side by side.

Someone in the group who prefers a dress can wear the [navy floral block print cotton maxi dress](/products/navy-floral-hand-block-print-cotton-maxi-dress/), which still fits a print theme while giving a different shape.

For the men and kids in your group, a simple white kurta with jeans or pyjamas works with every theme on this list.

## Planning tips for group orders

- **Decide the theme early.** Share a few photos in your family or friends chat and agree on colours first.
- **Collect measurements.** With free custom fit, each person shares bust, waist, hip and height, and we stitch to measure at no extra cost. Our guide on [how to measure](/blog/how-to-measure-yourself-for-a-custom-kurta-set/) makes this easy.
- **Order together.** Made-to-measure pieces take 5 to 7 working days plus about 5 to 10 business days for delivery, so order at least 3 to 4 weeks before Holi.
- **Check addresses.** If your group lives in different countries, we ship free with tracking to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia.

## Make the photos count

Take your group photos early, before the colours start, and again at the end when everyone is covered in gulal. The before-and-after pair is always a favourite. Stand in open shade rather than harsh sun for the best light, and put the brightest colours in the middle of the group.

## Frequently asked questions

**How do we coordinate Holi outfits without looking identical?**
Choose one shared element, such as a colour, a print style or a white base, and let each person choose their own silhouette.

**What colours look best in Holi group photos?**
White and pastels show colour beautifully. A pastel rainbow, with each person in a different soft shade, looks lovely together.

**Can people in different countries order matching outfits?**
Yes. We ship free with tracking to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, so each person can receive their outfit at home.

**How early should a group order for Holi?**
At least 3 to 4 weeks before Holi, especially for made-to-measure pieces, so everyone's outfit arrives on time.
